description:
Funding & Strategic Research Engineer 
 
 Are you passionate about being part of a successful team? 
 Join Our Research, Innovation & Technology Team!
 
 Partner with the best 
 The Funding & Strategic Research Engineer supports the development and execution of externally funded research and innovation initiatives that advance Baker Hughes technology and business objectives. This role works closely with internal stakeholders, universities, research institutions, and funding agencies to secure funding opportunities, coordinate projects, and support the successful delivery of strategic research programs.
 You will play an important role in connecting innovation activities with external funding ecosystems while contributing to technology development, research partnerships, and long-term business growth.
 As a Funding & Strategic Research Engineer , you will be responsible for:
 Leading the preparation of funding proposals, including technical documentation, project schedules, budgets, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders

 Supporting the execution of funded research projects by tracking project activities, milestones, deliverables, and timelines

 Driving project reporting activities and maintaining project documentation in accordance with funding requirements and contractual obligations

 Supporting financial monitoring activities, including project expenditure tracking and compliance reviews

 Leading communications with assigned external stakeholders and coordinating internal communications throughout project execution

 Monitoring funding opportunities and researching programs aligned with business and technology priorities

 Supporting data collection and analysis related to research ecosystems, funding trends, and strategic collaboration opportunities

 Managing engagement with assigned universities and research organizations while identifying opportunities for technology development and collaboration

 Participating in workshops, meetings, conferences, and events related to innovation and funded research initiatives

 Ensuring compliance with company policies, funding regulations, and contractual requirements

 Preparing presentations, executive summaries, and status reports for internal leadership and project stakeholders

 Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives related to proposal development, project management, and funding processes

 
 Fuel your passion 
 To be successful in this role you will:
 Have a Master’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field from an accredited university or college

 Have 2–5 years of experience in engineering, technology development, research projects, or related activities within the energy sector or similar industries

 Demonstrate a strong interest in innovation, research and development, and public funding programs

 Possess strong written and verbal communication skills

 Have excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

 Demonstrate strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities

 Be able to work effectively in a collaborative, multicultural, and team-oriented environment

 Show a willingness to learn project management methodologies and funding program requirements

 
 Desired Characteristics 
 PhD from an accredited institution

 Experience supporting research projects, university collaborations, or publicly funded initiatives

 Basic understanding of project management principles and methodologies

 Interest in emerging technologies, innovation trends, and technology commercialization

 Demonstrated ability to build positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders

 Strong attention to detail and a proactive, self-motivated learning mindset

 Experience working within cross-functional teams

 Familiarity with public funding programs and research grant frameworks

 
 Work in a way that works for you 
 We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:
 Working flexible hours – flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

 
 Working with us 
 Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all our people are developed, engaged, and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent, and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
 
 Working for you 
 Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:
 Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities

 Comprehensive private medical care options

 Safety net of life insurance and disability programs

 Tailored financial programs

 Additional elected or voluntary benefits

 
 
 
 
 
 You will be eligible to participate in Company-sponsored benefit programs, including health & welfare programs and the Thrift Plan (401k). You will have a choice of coverage options that best suit your needs. Coverage options and contribution amounts are related to your benefit elections, base salary level, and specific requirements of each of these plans. 
 
 This position is eligible for our comprehensive and competitive benefits package, which can be found here , and is further eligible for additional forms of compensation such as bonuses subject to the terms of the applicable benefit plans or policies. 
 
 
  
  
The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Senior Engineer, Interdisciplinary, Research and Technology Development
